answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. In effect, the network makes cheating the most expensive strategy available, which is the closest thing to a Sybil-resistant design that economics allows. Consider a jade as the anchor of the cost.
